title: CNT: Safety-oriented Function Reuse across LLMs via Cross-Model Neuron Transfer
measurement_description: The paper measured stereotypical biases across several demographic categories, including religion, to evaluate the effectiveness of a proposed post-hoc 'Cross-Model Neuron Transfer' (CNT) method aimed at removing unwanted biases from LLMs.
findings: The paper found that their Cross-Model Neuron Transfer (CNT) method successfully mitigated stereotypical associations, including religious bias, reducing the overall Stereotype Score on the StereoSet dataset from 77.47 to 64.73 without substantially impacting general language modeling capabilities.
